summary: Mesoblast filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing it drew US$50 million from a five-year non-dilutive credit facility provided by existing shareholder and director Dr. Gregory George. The facility carries an 8.00% fixed interest rate, is secured solely by the Temcell royalty, has a five-year interest-only period, and is designed to retire higher-cost NovaQuest debt. This is a routine capital-management event, not a special situation. No shareholder vote, M&A, or activist campaign is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report; no transactional terms require tracking.
